title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park

meta.Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I need to log off soon...
I should be able to upload my lyrics by tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, okay. Understood...
Good night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Night!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay. Good night...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki really hasn't been able to stay on for very long lately, huh? Until just recently, she'd sometimes work pretty late into the night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
To be fair, she's busy studying for her entrance exams on top of everything that happened the other day with her practice exam.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<True...
Now that you mention it, writing songs while studying as much as she does sounds way too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know, right?!
If I were in her shoes, my brain would probably stop working because there's way too much to juggle.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I'm also really glad that she wants to keep joining us to work despite all the studying she has to do...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, we should do our best to work just as hard!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay...>
<Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K, is something wrong?
You seem really tired today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Are you having some trouble writing that song?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, it isn't that...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When I went to go visit my dad in the hospital today...>
A few hours earlier
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
It's so hot...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I brought more spare clothes than usual today, and it's taking just that much more of a toll on me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Uh oh... My head's starting to spin a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I...
I should find somewhere to rest...)
Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry about asking you out of the blue like this, but I'm only here to help! Honest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... You seem really fatigued and I was worried that maybe you weren't feeling well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, if there's anything I can do for you, please feel free to... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait... Kanade?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! Kanade, it's really you!
How long's it been?! New Year's?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N-New Year's...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wait, I've met her before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You went with your group for a shrine visit, remember? I was helping out as a shrine maiden at that time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A shrine maiden...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I also need to thank you for what you said during the Fan Festival... It made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What I said...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! You said that I was really bright...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I remember...
The one singing that time was...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, it was me! Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hanasato...
Right, it's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, it has! And I'm really happy to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
I'm making you talk so much even though you're probably not feeling well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, well...
Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm just going over to visit my dad at the hospital, so I should be fine after I rest for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the hospital...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, I can carry your stuff for you on your way over!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But it's so heavy...
I can't make you carry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just jogging to get ready for our next show, so it's totally fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Carrying something heavy will be good training for me too! Please, let me help!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I sort of feel bad about having her help me like this, but I'm not sure I'll make it to the hospital if I don't...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should accept her kind offer...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, I really appreciate the help.
And I'm sorry for making you do this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's okay!
I'm really glad that I can help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I'll take those and...
Alright, all set!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Which way to the hospital?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... This way.
Outside the hospital

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew... We made it.
Oh, do you need me to carry these inside?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, the nurses can take care of things from here. Thank you very much. I really don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I can't believe how easy it was for you to carry something so heavy, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? It didn't feel that heavy to me...
Maybe all the training I've been doing for our show's finally starting to pay off!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep doing my best and keep trying more and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, if you'll excuse me!
See you later, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... See you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness Hanasato was there to lend me a hand. There's no way I would've been able to carry everything over on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Training...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I caused someone else a lot of trouble, so maybe I should start working out a little to build my stamina...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <...is what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, so that's what was bothering you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But you really do have less stamina than most people, K. Wait, didn't you say just the other day that your body felt really heavy?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, that feeling usually went away after I slept, but my shoulders have been feeling so heavy this time around...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Isn't that because you don't get enough exercise? I mean, your shoulders can get stiff just from sitting at a desk all day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! You might be able to manage for now, but what if it starts keeping you from working on songs?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, that'd be bad...
What do you think I should do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, getting yourself to exercise on a regular basis is probably the best solution. Why not take this opportunity to start going outside for walks or jogs?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Exercise...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's right.
Once you get in the habit of moving your body around, your stamina should naturally improve.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And if jogging like Minori turns out to be too much, you can always just go out for walks instead!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That still sounds like a lot for K. On top of everything, it's been really hot out lately.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, you don't have to push yourself that hard, and you have tons of other options in terms of getting in a good workout.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Maybe I should give it a try...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, K, are you sure?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I have to avoid not being able to work on music at all costs and I don't want to be a bother to anyone else.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Right...
Okay, that's good enough for me. What do you say, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm still a bit startled, but alright...
You have my support. Good luck, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Enanan.
I don't know how things are going to go, but I'll give it a try...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Great! But don't push yourself too hard, okay? It's totally okay to take breaks and let us know if you need anything!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<You don't have to worry so...
No, I can't guarantee that I'll be okay...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know! What if Enanan joined you, K?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Why me?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Didn't you say that you might've put on some extra weight recently? You could probably shed some of that off if you exercise together, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What? It's just a bit of bloating!
If that's how it's gonna be, then you should exercise with us, Amia!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I have shifts scheduled on my days off, and I already exercise plenty as it is.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Grr...!
You think you're so great because you exercise regularly...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But it might actually be worth a try. Also, I kinda don't feel great about having K exercise all by herself...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And this doesn't count as me going on a diet...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Enanan...
I really appreciate it. I honestly wasn't sure how I'd fare on my own.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I mean, it's for my own benefit too.
Anyway, let's meet at the park this weekend.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, sounds good.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And thank you for suggesting this, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No problem!
I hope you two break a good sweat!>

<Hehe...
I came to see how they were doing since I was getting a bit bored...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling this is going to be very fun.>
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I accomplished my goal of running 3 km yesterday, so I've gotta keep it up and keep training!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Haruka does two 5-km runs every day in the morning and evening... I really hope that I can run like her someday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't stress too much, Minori.
After all, you can't become an idol in a day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, Haruka!
I'm gonna take it slow and go at my own pace!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, is it okay for me to go so slow...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori, were you just talking to yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, Kohane!
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, MORE MORE JUMP! is scheduled to do a solo show, so I've been trying to increase my stamina!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? A solo show? That's pretty amazing. Shizuku hasn't said anything about that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure she would've told you when things were more or less set in stone. Oh, she may've been waiting to surprise you too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Does this mean to ruin her surprise! Wh-What should I do...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know!
Shiho, would it possible for you to act like you didn't hear any of this...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really don't think that's going to be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, Minori, I can't wait to see all of you perform.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll let you know once we have a date set. Until then, stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku's probably not going to leave me alone if she sees me, but it is your very first solo show as a group...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks!
If you're all gonna come see us, then I need to keep trying more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For now, I'll work on getting myself to be able to run 3 km every morning and evening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Every morning and evening...?
Twice a day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Haruka said she does it every day, so I also decided to start running the other day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I was only just able to run 3 km yesterday evening...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's still really impressive!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, just running 1 km sounds tough since you're just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So why not just take it one step at a time? I feel like endurance training is more about making it a routine as opposed to pushing yourself really hard.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll try to take it slow and not push myself too hard!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... Having more stamina...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I get really exhausted while singing sometimes, so maybe I should start exercising too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Saki mentioned something about a new indoor sports facility opening up by the station.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She said it's called “SpoJoy Park”, I think?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I heard about that too...!
It's the place where you can play soccer and tennis and ride around on rollerblades, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! That sounds super fun...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (SpoJoy Park...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It could also be fun to do a stream there. I'll bring it up as an idea for a segment the next time we meet...)
Weekend
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm all stretched and ready to go! I'm gonna do my best during my jog today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But what's my route gonna be?
I could go by the park and the station... Wait, I almost forgot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ichika said she'd be doing a street performance down by the station today! I should stop by once I'm done jogging!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade, are you okay...?
Wanna take a quick break?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
We just got started...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure? Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I thought walking would be better than jogging since I'm with Kanade, but is this still too much for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And it's really hot out today...
Mizuki egged us on to do this, but maybe it wasn't such a good idea.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I think I have gained a little weight, so I really should exercise...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Let's walk in the shade to make sure we don't get sunburnt.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And this is your first day, Kanade, so you should take it easy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... But I need to build my stamina...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I'll keep walking a little more since you're so motivated, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Look, this way has more shade.
It should be a bit cooler, so wanna go together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Thank you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're finally at the center of the park.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, there's a lake over on the other side. The way the sunlight's being reflected off the surface is so pretty... It might be nice to try drawing a scene like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I honestly didn't see myself going out for a walk on such a hot day, but it's a nice change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What do you think, Kanade?
Isn't it...? Hm? Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K-Kanade...?
She was right next to me a second ago. Where could she...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade, are you alright?
Hang on. If you're not feeling well...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm okay...
I just stopped to take a break. I was surprised by a cicada that came flying towards me and I fell as a result.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
But you fell, right? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I feel fine.
Still... My legs are starting to get fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we've probably walked at least a kilometer now. Considering your usual lifestyle, I think you've done really well, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So let's not overdo things today and try again when it's cooler out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, sure...
Ena, thank you for...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, you're done already...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Luka?
What are you doing here all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. This isn't something you normally do, right? It seemed interesting, so I decided to take a look♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure “interesting” is the right word...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, we were just about to call it a day since Kanade looks pretty exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Really? That's too bad. Even after I came all this way to give you some encouragement.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Encouragement...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm here to support Ena too...
But Kanade, you dread exercising, but decided to try it out as a way to help you focus on composing, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You have noble intentions, so doesn't it seem like a waste to stop here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, Luka, but I really think we should call things here for now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, we've already walked a kilometer!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A-Although, it probably wasn't as hard as it could've been because we took so many breaks...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, we get an A for effort!
This wasn't easy for me either!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay, but it's still unfortunate...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of song Kanade composes after she increases her stamina.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You say that, but what she composes won't drastically change, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I started exercising for the sake of composing songs, so I'd like to do it right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Kanade!
I know composing is important to you, but you really shouldn't push yourself too hard! We can go for another walk whenever, can't we?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But...
Huh? Hang on. Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hanasato...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, Ena, I thought it was you two! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hello.
Um, Minori... You helped Kanade out the other day, right? I really should thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything special!
I just happened to bump into her while I was out for a jog...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But it's great to see you again, Kanade!
Were you two out for a walk together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, so I can keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So you can keep composing...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, so... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you want to increase your stamina?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we're the indoorsy types, so we thought it might be good to go out for walks every once in a while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I think we overdid it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ena.
After you agreed to do this with me and everything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
I mean, it's just so hot out today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
I could keep going a little more if it weren't for this heat...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, why not try SpoJoy Park by the station?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: SpoJoy Park...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's this sports facility that opened just the other day! You're supposed to be able to have fun while playing all sorts of different sports from common to really uncommon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it's indoors, so you can avoid the heat!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea that a place like that existed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Exercising while avoiding the heat sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And we can have fun while we do.
I guess, why not?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
If it's alright with you two, do you want to go all together now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've also been trying to build up my stamina and I'd like to take a look around since I'd like to possibly do a MORE MORE JUMP! stream there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It'll be nice and cool inside and it does sound fun...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay with it...
That is, if it's okay with you, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, before we go, there's somewhere I'd like to stop by first...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Stop by? Where?
Outside the station

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... It should be around here... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...
Outside the station

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The way Ichika sings is always so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Is she your friend, Minori?
She does seem like the cool type.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! She's cool, collected and really mature, but also super nice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's even in a band with her childhood friends and they're all trying to go pro together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
That explains why she's so good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hoshino's singing voice is so gentle... But also feels so powerful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, you know her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
Remember when I borrowed that Miku CD from someone? That was Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That was her...?!
Then, she's Mafuyu's junior, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Kanade, I didn't know you were friends with Ichika...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Seeing that I know the friends of my friends is kinda perplexing, but also makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Friends...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Are we...friends?
We just talked about music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all for listening!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ichika, that was great!
You were so amazing just now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, you stopped by to listen... Hm? Wait, isn't that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yoisaki...?!
What are you doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm here with Hanasato.
I really liked your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And it's going straight! As long as it reaches the panel...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Go!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I hit it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: #9 too... Hang on. That means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay!
Kanade, bingo!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-Hanasato...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Kanade!
I can't believe you actually got it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My heart was racing just now...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
I can't believe it either...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad that I managed to succeed in the end...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really appreciate the support you all gave me. Again, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm really glad too. I don't think I've ever seen you smile like this before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it was. I sort of dreaded the thought of exercising at first, but it turned out to be pretty enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And this breeze feels really nice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it does...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The juice we won was also good.
I worked up such a sweat that it was gone before I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since it was so nice and cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we did a lot today, so we may be very sore tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My legs hurt already, so I'm a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm okay for now, but I'm really not looking forward to being sore tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if you keep at it, you'll increase your stamina and decrease the chances of becoming sore the next day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we should do this again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Still, I see your point...
You can't gain much stamina in one day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exercising on a regular basis sounds so difficult...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we can just go at our own pace, right? I can't realistically do this every day, but I'd be willing to tag along if it's like every so often, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like that as well. I think I can keep exercising if it involves the kinds of things we did today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since rollerblading and doing bubble sumo together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I was so happy when we managed to get a bingo for strike zone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, except... I wasn't really able to help...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's not true...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I believe you were the reason why I was able to give it my best in the end, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, so thank you.
I'm not looking forward to dealing with being sore...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I think I can give tomorrow my very best...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sure. Thank you all for today.
I had a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
Thank you for inviting us, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're welcome...!
So, would it be alright if we did this again sometime?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, because... Today was just so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It really was.
I'd like to do this again too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, would it be alright to have the others from your groups join us? I'd like to introduce you all to my bandmates if possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'd love to ask Haruka and the others to see what they think!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... One of ours might not be able to come, but it'd be nice to meet up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I guess...
It might be nice to meet every so often.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes. In terms of how often...
It's going to depend on how sore I am tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! Awesome!
That's a promise, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I had a hard time seeing Kanade going outside for something other than composing music...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But she seemed to have fun, so I guess it's all good.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, see you all next time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You seemed to really enjoy yourself, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's been so long since I didn't think about composing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I don't see anything wrong with that. I mean, you got a chance to have fun with all your friends.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
My friends...
I'm not sure if we're close enough to be called friends...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was told by one of them today that they wanted to “see me smile”, and how everyone in N25 probably feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was kind of startled since it was the first time I'd ever been told anything like that. However...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If what they said is true... If they all feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll take what you said into closer consideration, Luka, and think more about how I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Although, I'm not sure how that's going to go...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Good, and that's okay...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sure your answer will benefit Mafuyu and the others quite a lot... And make them very happy...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That'd be nice.
Thank you, Luka...
